about_the_game:
Coloring Game 10K is a new game of the franchise, coloring by numbers. It is a bright representative of anti-stress games.

  • All pictures in the game has a size of 10,000 px.

  • Size: 90 images / 900,000 px.

  • Duration: 25 hours (Pen Mode) / 13 hours (Fill Mode)
